description: District 27 is one of the most beautiful and varied districts in our state. From Lookout Mountain and Lookout Valley to Red Bank, Signal Mountain, Hixson, Soddy Daisy, Mowbray Mountain, Flat Top Mountain, and Bakewell, our communities are a mix of urban edge, suburban neighborhoods, and rural mountain land.
